assets.purpose: README hero: from tangled writing to clear communication
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: panoramic GitHub README hero illustration for an open-source writing skill named talk-like-a-human.
Primary request: create a sophisticated, distinctive editorial illustration that communicates turning tangled AI writing into clear, faithful human communication.
Composition: very wide horizontal canvas, exact 3:1 aspect ratio, preferably 2400 x 800. One cohesive composition, fully framed with 7% safe margins. Left third: a few overlapping off-white paper fragments with inconsistent short slate-gray lines, awkwardly grouped punctuation-like strokes, and a small restrained tangle of fine lines. Middle: a single confident burnt-orange editorial stroke gently routes the messy material through a slim open rectangular frame. Right third: a single beautifully aligned, clean ivory speech/document card with three or four neatly spaced complete line groups, a small discrete outlined verification check, and generous whitespace. Visually preserve the material through the transformation: clarity, not deleting all information.
Style/medium: polished modern technical-editorial illustration; mostly flat vector-like geometry with subtly layered paper edges, minimal soft shadows and an almost imperceptible fine paper texture. Precise, calm and professional, suitable for a serious open-source developer project. A little dimensional depth is welcome, but no cartoon.
Palette: warm near-white #FAF9F6 background, graphite #172033, cool slate #718096, one restrained burnt-orange #EA6A24 accent. Mostly neutral, orange under 12% of the image. Crisp contrast.
Text: absolutely no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no title, no logo. Document marks must be abstract typographic strokes only. The repository will place its title and localized copy as real text outside the image.
Constraints: no emoji, no people, no robot, no brain, no neon, no colorful gradients, no generic tech circuitry, no decorative stars, no watermark. The scene must still read clearly when scaled to 850 pixels wide.

assets.purpose: Supporting illustration: establish facts, write, review
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide supporting editorial illustration for the "How it works" section of an open-source AI writing skill.
Primary request: visually tell a three-part writing process: establish facts, write clear sentences, then review wording and fidelity.
Composition: exact 3:1 horizontal canvas, preferably 2400 x 800. Three equally sized editorial vignettes in one continuous horizontal composition with ample space between them, equal visual weight and no boxed UI dashboard. First vignette: three small orderly source-note sheets and one simple fine outline magnifying glass focusing on a few source lines. Second vignette: a neatly drafted document with full-length evenly spaced abstract line groups and one burnt-orange pencil poised beside it. Third vignette: a clean final document with an understated three-item outline checklist and a precise outlined verification check. Two very thin directional connectors join the three scenes. All scenes fully inside 8% outer margins, aligned on the same baseline.
Style/medium: sophisticated modern technical-editorial illustration, precise almost-flat geometric paper forms with subtle paper layering, delicate soft shadows and a barely visible paper texture. Professional and restrained, no cute characters. Match a warm-ivory, orange and cool-slate open-source project identity.
Palette: warm near-white #FAF9F6 background, graphite #172033, cool slate #718096, sparing burnt-orange #EA6A24 accents. Mostly neutral.
Text: no readable text, no letters, no numerals, no headings, no logos. Abstract document lines only. All captions will be selectable native Markdown outside the image.
Constraints: no emoji, no people, no robot, no brain, no neon, no colorful gradients, no glossy 3D toys, no decorative stars, no watermark. Simple enough to understand at mobile size. This is a conceptual editorial illustration, not an exact software architecture diagram.

assets.purpose: Chinese illustration: one glossary for consistent terminology across docs and code
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a beautiful panoramic editorial illustration for the Advanced: consistent terminology section of the open-source writing skill Talk Like a Human.
Primary request: illustrate one project glossary used as a reference to check terminology across documents and source code. Create a refined, art-directed composition that feels like a premium tactile paper sculpture photographed in a studio, matching an existing warm ivory, graphite and burnt-orange README identity.
Composition: exact 3:1 landscape aspect ratio, preferably 2400 x 800. Central focal point: one beautifully crafted small open reference book, slightly rotated in an elegant three-quarter overhead view, its ivory pages visibly layered with a restrained burnt-orange cloth spine and thin orange ribbon bookmark. The open spread contains simple slate typographic bars and one clearly outlined orange terminology highlight. Four smaller floating paper cards arranged around the book in a balanced, gently asymmetric constellation, two on each side: a prose document, a code page with abstract indented line groups, a compact technical note, and a report. Each card contains the SAME short orange highlighted bar amongst slate lines to represent the same project term. Faint precise slate connector lines associate the cards with the reference book; no arrowheads, no motion streaks, no suggestion of automatically editing files. Keep the cards individually legible, generously separated, and fully inside 7% outer safe margins. The reference book is the clear focal point; cards have varied but harmonious angles and restrained depth. This is one cohesive still life, not a boxed dashboard or a three-step row.
Style/medium: sophisticated technical-editorial paper sculpture, crisp thin paper edges, subtle page curvature and folded corners, quiet physically plausible dimensional depth, soft broad studio lighting from upper left with delicate contact shadows. Matte materials, almost imperceptible paper grain. Carefully composed, calm and confident, beautiful without clutter. Good visual hierarchy even at 850 px display width.
Palette: near-white warm ivory #FAF9F6 backdrop and paper, cool slate #718096 lines, dark graphite #172033 details, restrained burnt orange #EA6A24 accents under 12% of the composition. Harmonize with an existing light README with paper-document illustrations.
Text: no readable text, no letters, no words, no numerals, no labels, no title, no watermark. Only abstract typographic bars; real bilingual captions are added as native Markdown outside the image.
Avoid: emoji, people, faces, robots, brains, neon, colorful gradients, glowing networks, glossy toy plastic, decorative stars, giant magnifying glasses, checkmark badges, tangled lines, UI screenshots, dense technical diagrams. Keep all substantive forms fully framed.
assets.typography_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Chinese localized GitHub README supporting illustration.
Input image: the provided paper-book glossary illustration is the edit target. Keep its elegant warm ivory, slate and burnt-orange palette, tactile matte paper, central open book, four surrounding connected cards, lighting, landscape 3:1 composition and delicate shadows.
Primary request: add precise, beautiful, highly readable Chinese typography and a concrete repeated terminology example. This should be a polished informative editorial illustration, not abstract decoration.
Text placement and verbatim text:
1. On the upper part of the left page of the central book, replace the anonymous dark heading bar with the exact large Chinese title "项目术语表". Under it add the smaller text "一个概念，一个名字".
2. On the right page of the central book, place the exact term "工作区" in its orange highlighted row. Make the row sufficiently broad and the text crisp, with high contrast.
3. Replace the heading bar at the top of the upper-left paper card with the exact label "文档". Put the exact term "工作区" in that card's orange highlighted row.
4. Label the lower-left code card "代码"; put the exact term "工作区" in its orange highlighted row.
5. Label the upper-right card "技术说明"; put the exact term "工作区" in its orange highlighted row.
6. Label the lower-right report card "报告"; put the exact term "工作区" in its orange highlighted row. Keep the existing small abstract bar chart.
Typography: professional Chinese sans serif with regular clear strokes, a medium/semibold weight for labels. Strong readable charcoal on ivory; charcoal or near-white on orange, whichever provides real contrast. Render all specified text verbatim, naturally printed on the paper with correct perspective, never gibberish. Make labels generous rather than microtext; readable at about 850px image width. Adapt line lengths and whitespace slightly to accommodate text. The only readable words should be those specified; remaining document marks stay abstract slate bars.
Constraints: preserve the conceptual reference connections without arrowheads. No extra outer headline, logo, footer, English, numbers, emoji or watermark. Do not add UI frames. Do not change the color identity or introduce new illustrations. Fully frame the book, ribbon and four cards.

assets.purpose: Illustrative rewrite: replace vague corporate phrasing with a concrete action
assets.source_note: Constructed from the customer-support example in references/zh-jargon.md; an illustration of the rule, not a recorded evaluation output.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit the provided editorial collage into a stronger feature illustration for a Chinese writing skill. Keep the selected B style: warm cream, cobalt-blue large shapes, vermilion orange accents, photographic silver scissors, torn typographic scraps, red proofreader curves, restrained print texture, asymmetric magazine layout. It must be a visually composed collage, not a table or giant text poster.
Change the example to show turning vague corporate language into a concrete statement about what someone can do. Replace every old phrase. Exact new text only:
Top short heading: "把黑话改成具体动作"
Input text on the upper-left torn strip or two adjacent torn strips: "开放订单状态查询能力，赋能客服团队"
Break input naturally after the comma onto a second line. Preserve all characters and keep them clearly readable.
Output label: "改写后"
Output phrase on the clean lower-right cutout: "客服能自己查订单状态"
Break output into two balanced lines if needed: "客服能自己" / "查订单状态".
Make the output phrase a visual anchor with strong whitespace and an orange background accent. Scissors cut only an unlettered tail of the input strip; do not suggest arbitrary deletion of the actual facts. Keep original input intact and legible. Adapt layout for the longer sentence: give text enough room, reduce the relative dominance of the scissors slightly, retain visual balance and the paper offcuts. The useful text should occupy around a quarter of the image, while scissors, shapes, textures and editorial marks carry the composition.
Remove the unrelated photographic forest filmstrip from the original. In its place use translucent cobalt tape and a few neutral checkered print textures, not pictures of scenery. No forests, mountains, people, laptops, paper books, extra symbols or microtext. No old "清洗" example remains. No other claims, numbers, English, logos or watermark. Preserve approximately 3:2 landscape ratio and professional magazine quality.

assets.purpose: Illustrative rewrite: reconnect a cause and its consequence without adding facts
assets.source_note: talk-like-a-human/references/zh-jargon.md, 为了省字硬删词; an illustrative rule example.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Create an art-directed editorial collage information graphic for a Chinese open-source writing skill. Landscape 1600 x 1100, approximately 3:2. Match a selected magazine collage identity: warm off-white paper #F7F2E8, broad cobalt-blue shapes #2854CB, vermilion #ED623E accents, deep ink lettering, real cut-paper fibers, photographic metallic detail, light analog print texture. This graphic explains adding back the causal relationship between two terse fragments.
Visual story and composition: at the upper left are two short rough-edged sentence strips that are physically separated by a visible gap, drifting at slightly different angles. Below and to the right, two clean sentence strips form an intentional continuous composition, held together by ONE oversized photographic silver paperclip and a confident orange joining stroke. The paperclip bridges the two strips like an editorial act of reconnecting meaning; this visual joining action should remain understandable even with the text covered. A cobalt half-circle or bold irregular shape behind the clip and a warm orange accent behind the final sentence create a distinctive asymmetric composition. A thin hand-drawn red editorial arc leads from the loose fragments to the connected statement. No scissors: this graphic adds missing relationships rather than trimming words. No books, screens, people, scenery, UI or three-dimensional document pages.
Only these exact text elements:
Small top heading: "把因果关系写完整"
The two upper-left loose strips read separately: "缓存未失效" and "数据旧"
Small label above the lower-right complete version: "改写后"
The two joined strips read, in clear reading order: "因为缓存没有失效，" and "所以页面上还是旧数据。"
Make "因为" and "所以" stand out with a subtle orange proofreader underline or highlight. The phrases are not captions on tiny objects: give them readable mid-sized Chinese sans serif type and enough physical space. The output must read as one connected statement. No extra text. Typography around 25% of the artwork; collage forms and the bridging paperclip carry the rest. Lots of breathing room, a polished magazine visual, not a comparison table or text poster. No fabricated facts, symbols, logos or watermark.
